description: Classify a number with a short flat sequence of guards: negative numbers return "negative", zero returns "zero", and any positive number returns a two-word label combining size ("small" when n <= 100, else "large") and parity ("even" when n is divisible by 2, else "odd"). Pure and deterministic, no exceptions on the integer domain. The golden arg_sets cover the value-returning domain only, including the decisive boundaries (0, the negative branch, the small/large cutoff at 100 vs 101, and even/odd at each size) so the golden discriminates an implementation that drops or swaps either half of the label.
